context: METHODS This was a retrospective, observational study using a large RFA database in a tertiary referral center. The primary outcome was time to CRIM compared between males and females. Covariates included age, race, smoking history, use of endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR), histology before RFA, and the number of RFA sessions.
target: Time to CRIM (in months) was calculated using the Kaplan-Meier method and compared using the log-rank test.
